title: Cyclic polyglycolide by means of metal acetylacetonates
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1757-1764
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07961F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Steffen M. Weidner, Andreas Meyer, Jana Falkenhagen, Hans R. Kricheldorf
Polymerizations of glycolide with various metal acetylacetonates showed that Zr(acac)4 is the most reactive catalyst, yielding low-molecular-weight cyclic poly(glycolide). The combination of WAXS and DSC measurements confirmed a ΔH0m of 206 J g−1.
